sections.name: View
sections.description:
View constructs a retained container from children. Configure it with fluent
properties, events, and styles. Apply reusable styles with Element.Style.

	return ui.Input().
		Value(value()).

		Width(320).Height(32)
}

go/ui/text-area.example:
func TextAreaExample() *ui.Element {
	value, setValue := ui.CreateSignal("")
	return ui.TextArea().
		Value(value()).
		Placeholder("Write here").
		OnInputEvent(func(event *native.Event) { setValue(event.Value) }).
		Width(320).Height(96)
}

<Field.Root required invalid={name().length === 0} validationMessage="Enter a name">
  <Field.Label><Text>Name</Text></Field.Label>
  <Field.Control value={name()} onInput={(event) => setName(event.value ?? "")} />
  <Field.Description><Text>Shown on your profile.</Text></Field.Description>
  <Field.Error><Text>Enter a name.</Text></Field.Error>
</Field.Root>

  viewportSize={{ width: 320, height: 240 }}
  contentSize={{ width: 320, height: 1200 }}
  onScrollStateChange={setScrollState}

entries.name: Ref
entries.description: Receives the retained native node after construction. Keep imperative work in event or lifecycle callbacks.

entries.name: Style
entries.description: Reusable layout, typography, color, and interaction-state styles. Build with ui.Style() and compose with Merge.

entries.name: Children
entries.description: Content mounted inside the component. Compound child callbacks run after the parent context exists.

entries.name: Disabled
entries.description: Prevents activation and exposes the disabled state to accessibility. Compound parts inherit a disabled root.

entries.name: Role
entries.description: Accessibility role override. Prefer the component’s built-in semantics.

entries.name: FocusOnPointer
entries.description: Whether a pointer press moves keyboard focus to the control.

entries.name: Group
entries.description: Names this element as a group for descendant interaction-state styling.

entries.name: AriaLabel
entries.description: Accessible name, especially for icon-only controls or controls without a visible label.

entries.name: TabIndex
entries.description: Controls sequential keyboard focus order. Omit to retain the component’s default focus behavior.

entries.name: OnClick
entries.description: Called after QuickGUI resolves an activation, including supported keyboard activation.

entries.name: OnDoubleClick
entries.description: Callback for double click. The signature below lists the event payload.

entries.name: OnContextMenu

<Table.Root
  columns={[{ id: "name", label: "Name" }, { id: "status", label: "Status" }]}
  rowCount={rows.length}
  onVisibleRangeChange={setVisibleRange}
>
  <Table.Header column="name"><Text>Name</Text></Table.Header>
  <For each={visibleRows()}>{(row) =>
    <Table.Row index={row.index}>
      <Table.Cell column="name"><Text>{row.name}</Text></Table.Cell>
      <Table.Cell column="status"><Text>{row.status}</Text></Table.Cell>
    </Table.Row>
  }</For>
</Table.Root>

typescript/ui/tree.example:
<Tree.Root
  nodes={nodes}
  expanded={expanded()}
  value={selected()}
  onExpandedChange={setExpanded}
  onValueChange={setSelected}
>
  <For each={visibleNodes()}>{(node) =>
    <Tree.Row nodeId={node.id}><Text>{node.label}</Text></Tree.Row>
  }</For>
</Tree.Root>

<Dialog.Root open={open()} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <Dialog.Trigger><Text>Edit profile</Text></Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Portal>
    <Dialog.Backdrop />
    <Dialog.Viewport>
      <Dialog.Popup>
        <Dialog.Title><Text>Edit profile</Text></Dialog.Title>
        <Dialog.Description><Text>Changes are saved immediately.</Text></Dialog.Description>
        <Dialog.Close><Text>Done</Text></Dialog.Close>
      </Dialog.Popup>
    </Dialog.Viewport>
  </Dialog.Portal>
</Dialog.Root>

typescript/ui/alert-dialog.example:
<AlertDialog.Root open={open()} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger><Text>Delete project</Text></AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Portal>
    <AlertDialog.Backdrop />
    <AlertDialog.Viewport>
      <AlertDialog.Popup>
        <AlertDialog.Title><Text>Delete this project?</Text></AlertDialog.Title>
        <AlertDialog.Description><Text>This cannot be undone.</Text></AlertDialog.Description>
        <AlertDialog.Close><Text>Cancel</Text></AlertDialog.Close>
      </AlertDialog.Popup>
    </AlertDialog.Viewport>
  </AlertDialog.Portal>
</AlertDialog.Root>

typescript/ui/toast.example:
const toast = useToastManager();

toast.add({ id: "saved", title: "Saved", description: "Your changes are live." });

<Toast.Provider timeout={5000} limit={3}>
  <Toast.Portal>
    <Toast.Viewport toasts={toast.toasts()} onDismiss={toast.dismiss}>
      <For each={toast.toasts()}>{(item) =>
        <Toast.Root toastId={item.id}>
          <Toast.Content><Toast.Title /><Toast.Description /></Toast.Content>
          <Toast.Close><Text>Close</Text></Toast.Close>
        </Toast.Root>
      }</For>
    </Toast.Viewport>
  </Toast.Portal>
</Toast.Provider>
